items.question: What payment modes can registered businesses use to pay UAE VAT through the EmaraTax platform?
items.gold: eDirham or credit card, eDebit, local bank transfer, and international bank transfer.
items.fact: EmaraTax VAT payment modes: eDirham, credit card, eDebit, bank transfers

items.question: Must registered businesses pay UAE VAT online through the EmaraTax platform?
items.gold: Yes, registered businesses must pay their tax online through EmaraTax.
items.fact: Registered businesses must pay tax online via EmaraTax
